scope: Application operating procedures; domain and off-app ownership review remains explicit.

procedures.title: Pick up an assigned referral
procedures.trigger: A case is assigned, reassigned or reopened for work.
procedures.outcome: The assessor knows which case is theirs, its current state and the next responsible action.
preconditions: Signed in to Pipeline with current access.
Use the existing referral; verify identity before acting.

steps.title: Find the assigned work
steps.action: Check the displayed owner/scope and the next action on the card. Open the intended client.
steps.expectedResult: The existing referral opens at its current work stage.

steps.title: Verify the case and owner
steps.action: Compare client details, community and assigned assessor with the work you were asked to do.
steps.expectedResult: Correct case and recorded owner are established.
steps.exception: If ownership or identity is unclear, ask the source owner to reconcile it before changing clinical work.

steps.title: Read the latest context
steps.action: Inspect relevant recent changes and then return to the current record.
steps.expectedResult: You can distinguish current state from an earlier change.

steps.title: Choose the next action
steps.action: Continue to the page named by the current task. Keep any unresolved ownership question explicit.
steps.expectedResult: An evidence-linked next action and responsible person are identified.

exceptions: A visible case is not proof that you own it.
After reassignment, recheck access and stop using an earlier cached brief.

agent.draftInstructions: Draft a case orientation: current state, recorded owner, known gaps, next existing source action and evidence links. Mark unavailable requirements as unavailable rather than absent.
agent.humanDecision: Assessor verifies identity and responsibility; authorized source operator resolves assignment changes.

procedures.title: Prepare an assessment from records
procedures.trigger: A new assessment or new evidence needs preparation.
procedures.outcome: A source-linked preparation brief and interview questions are ready, with unknowns preserved.
preconditions: Open the correct referral.
Use only evidence you are authorized to inspect.

steps.title: Inspect the originals
steps.action: Open the relevant original document. Check the person, document date and source.
steps.expectedResult: Evidence is inspected in its original context.

steps.title: Open preparation
steps.action: Use the preparation view where available; it edits the same canonical assessment. For an existing interview, return to the relevant section rather than creating another assessment.
steps.expectedResult: The existing assessment and its recorded values are visible.

steps.title: Compare recorded information
steps.action: Review prior information with its source and date. Keep current and historical statements separate.
steps.expectedResult: Differences and unknowns remain attributable.

steps.title: Review proposed values
steps.action: Confirm or correct imported suggestions using the source review controls when shown. Do not treat accepted extraction as client confirmation.
steps.expectedResult: Imported values retain accurate source/review state.
steps.exception: If the source cannot be inspected, leave the value pending or uncertainty explicit.

steps.title: Prepare remaining questions
steps.action: Use applicable fields to identify what still needs asking. Record only supplied facts; keep an interview agenda separate from asserted answers.
steps.expectedResult: A question list distinguishes missing, conflicting and unverified information.

steps.title: Confirm saved work
steps.action: Wait for the saved state before navigating away.
steps.expectedResult: The source confirms the current edits were saved.

exceptions: Conflicting sources remain separate until a person resolves them.
Do not carry an old answer forward as a current fact without checking its relevance.

agent.draftInstructions: Prepare a concise brief with known facts, sources/dates, conflicting accounts and specific interview questions. Cite each factual statement. Do not infer a negative answer from missing information.
agent.humanDecision: Assessor verifies source interpretation and accepts any field changes in Pipeline.

procedures.title: Schedule or reschedule an assessment
procedures.trigger: An encounter needs an appointment or a revised time.
procedures.outcome: Pipeline records the correct appointment or its actual exception status.
preconditions: Open the intended assessment.
Confirm coordination details through the approved human communication process.

steps.title: Open scheduling
steps.action: Choose Schedule interview for a new appointment, or Edit/Change appointment when shown.
steps.expectedResult: Scheduling opens for this referral.

steps.title: Set date and duration
steps.action: Check the displayed time zone, then set date, time and duration.
steps.expectedResult: The proposed appointment details are visible.

steps.title: Choose the method
steps.action: Choose in person, phone, Zoom or record review as applicable; supply the corresponding details.
steps.expectedResult: Method and coordination details agree.

steps.title: Save the appointment
clickpath: Schedule interview / Schedule record review / Save new time
steps.action: Review the details and choose the displayed save action once. Wait for success.
steps.expectedResult: The saved appointment appears in the assessment and Calendar.
steps.exception: For a conflict or failed save, inspect the message and resolve it; do not claim booking succeeded.

steps.title: Check the actual outcome
steps.action: Use the available source action when the encounter is completed, cancelled or a no-show. Reschedule through the same linked assessment when needed.
steps.expectedResult: The recorded status describes what actually happened.

exceptions: Scheduling does not start an interview.
A missed encounter does not complete the assessment.
External calendar synchronization is not assumed.

agent.draftInstructions: Prepare a scheduling brief with known details and unresolved coordination questions. Explain the source conflict or missing prerequisite. Do not select a time or contact anyone on the assessor’s behalf.
agent.humanDecision: The assessor confirms and saves the appointment through Pipeline.

procedures.title: Conduct and document the assessment
procedures.trigger: The assessor begins or resumes the encounter.
procedures.outcome: Answers and progress reflect the encounter, with sources and unresolved questions preserved.
preconditions: Verify the person and correct assessment.
Use applicable professional judgment and current approved guidance.

steps.title: Begin or resume deliberately
steps.action: Use the explicit begin action when starting. Resume the existing assessment if work already began. Switching views alone does not start an encounter.
steps.expectedResult: The actual lifecycle state is recorded.

steps.title: Choose the relevant section
steps.action: Select the topic needed; sections do not have to be completed in display order.
steps.expectedResult: Applicable questions for that section are visible.

steps.title: Record the information
steps.action: Enter supplied facts in the canonical field. Attribute client report, collateral, record or observation, and distinguish history from current information.
steps.expectedResult: Answers address the active question without invented conclusions.

steps.title: Revisit earlier answers
steps.action: Open an earlier answer when clarification is needed and preserve relevant uncertainty.
steps.expectedResult: The same assessment is updated rather than duplicated.

steps.title: Confirm progress and saves
steps.action: Check save state and continue to the next applicable section. Leave unresolved items visible for follow-up.
steps.expectedResult: Saved progress and remaining work are distinguishable.

exceptions: Unknown information remains unknown.
A completed interview is distinct from a signature, decision and sent packet.

agent.draftInstructions: Suggest specific follow-up questions based on supplied gaps. Draft clear wording only from provided evidence, retaining attribution, dates and uncertainty. Do not diagnose or make placement decisions.
agent.humanDecision: Assessor conducts the encounter, confirms facts and records answers.

procedures.title: Review answer quality and sign
procedures.trigger: Assessment work is ready for review or has unresolved gaps.
procedures.outcome: The assessor reviews content and source blockers, then explicitly signs when ready.
preconditions: Use the current assessment version.
Resolve source validation errors and pending saves.

steps.title: Open the review
steps.action: Inspect the assembled assessment and the source’s incomplete items.
steps.expectedResult: Full assessment review is open.

steps.title: Check evidence and completeness
steps.action: Resolve required missing information and pending imported values using their original source.
steps.expectedResult: Mechanical blockers are resolved or remain explicitly open.

steps.title: Improve the answer
steps.action: Check whether the answer addresses the question, names its source, separates current/history, and preserves uncertainty. Remove unsupported or irrelevant wording.
steps.expectedResult: A clearer answer preserves the same supported facts.

steps.title: Check successful persistence
steps.action: Wait for saved status; resolve any conflict or error before signing.
steps.expectedResult: The version being reviewed is saved.

steps.title: Sign explicitly
clickpath: Sign & continue to decision / Sign assessment
steps.action: Review the confirmation and choose Sign assessment only when you are ready and authorized.
steps.expectedResult: The source displays signature evidence for the assessment.

steps.title: Recognize the next boundary
steps.action: Read the recorded signature. Editing remains possible until signed-and-sent finalization under current source rules.
steps.expectedResult: A signature is not mistaken for a sent packet or admission.

exceptions: Do not manufacture facts to clear a required field.
Agent wording is a proposal; the assessor reviews it.
A local walkthrough completion cannot sign the record.

agent.draftInstructions: Produce field-specific findings with evidence, explanation and proposed wording. Separate mechanical completeness from quality. Preserve facts and uncertainty, avoid grading the employee, and stop short of signing.
agent.humanDecision: Assessor accepts or rejects edits and performs the signature action.

procedures.title: Record a recommendation and support the decision
procedures.trigger: There is enough evidence to express a recommendation or an authorized human is ready to decide.
procedures.outcome: Recommendation and admission decision remain distinct, attributable records.
preconditions: Confirm who is responsible for the decision.
Use current source permissions and assessment evidence.

steps.title: Review the working recommendation
steps.action: Where available, record the recommendation and its supported reason. Wait for its save to complete.
steps.expectedResult: The recommendation is saved independently of the admission decision.

steps.title: Open Decision
steps.action: Inspect the existing recommendation, decision and any unresolved requirements.
steps.expectedResult: The current decision context is visible.

steps.title: Record the authorized decision
steps.action: The responsible authorized person records the actual outcome and supported reason. A direct decision can exist without a new supervisor-review submission.
steps.expectedResult: The source confirms the recorded decision.

steps.title: Add the admission date when applicable
steps.action: For an accepted referral, enter the known planned date. Leave an unknown date unresolved instead of inventing it.
steps.expectedResult: The saved date reflects the agreed plan.

steps.title: Choose the appropriate next path
clickpath: Continue to finish & send when applicable
steps.action: Continue to handoff preparation for accepted work, or follow the appropriate declined/pending path.
steps.expectedResult: The next step matches the recorded outcome.

exceptions: A recommendation is not an admission decision.
New recommendations no longer automatically create supervisor reviews.
Admission confirmation is a separately authorized action.

agent.draftInstructions: Draft an evidence brief and proposed rationale, exposing unresolved facts. Distinguish recommendation from decision and do not choose acceptance or decline autonomously.
agent.humanDecision: The responsible person records the recommendation/decision and date through Pipeline.

procedures.title: Prepare the client handoff
procedures.trigger: An accepted referral needs a current, usable handoff.
procedures.outcome: A reviewed handoff draft identifies supported facts, outstanding work and the next owner.
preconditions: For a real Meet the Client send: accepted decision, signed assessment and valid planned admission date.
Check current identity, selected files and assessment/packet versions.
Agent email remains disabled; this procedure prepares and reviews the handoff.

steps.title: Inspect the handoff context
steps.action: Confirm the actual decision and planned date; inspect the assessment’s signature separately.
steps.expectedResult: Prerequisites are known rather than inferred from one status.

steps.title: Open the packet workspace
steps.action: Open the existing summary and packet workspace. Opening it sends nothing.
steps.expectedResult: The packet review is available.

steps.title: Review the summary
steps.action: Check factual accuracy, attribution and the current assessment version. Make open questions and the next responsible person clear.
steps.expectedResult: The handoff is usable and supported by the source.

steps.title: Verify selected files
steps.action: Open the selected evidence and verify the client, relevance and current versions. Exclude unrelated material.
steps.expectedResult: The selected packet matches the intended handoff.

steps.title: Inspect the email draft
steps.action: Review the proposed audience, subject, body and attachments. Close the preview to leave it unsent.
steps.expectedResult: A human-reviewed draft exists; no delivery is claimed.

steps.title: Treat delivery as a separate outcome
steps.action: If an independently authorized human sends through the source app, verify the source delivery record for the exact version. This walkthrough and the agent do not send.
steps.expectedResult: Delivery is either source-confirmed or remains unconfirmed.
steps.exception: For stale preview, refresh and review again. For an uncertain provider outcome, reconcile before considering another send.

exceptions: A preview or signature is not successful delivery.
Missing delivery evidence means unconfirmed, not necessarily unsent.
A successful send does not prove recipient acknowledgment.

agent.draftInstructions: Draft: purpose, supported current information, important uncertainty, pending items with owner/next action, and source links. Attach a readiness list. Do not invent facts or recipients and do not send email.
agent.humanDecision: Human reviews the draft, audience and attachments. Any future delivery uses separate explicit authorization and current source checks.

procedures.title: Correct an assessment after new information
procedures.trigger: A correction or new evidence affects an existing assessment.
procedures.outcome: The appropriate edit or note preserves the earlier record and its lineage.
preconditions: Verify the exact assessment and whether signed-and-sent finalization occurred.

steps.title: Check finality
steps.action: Determine whether the assessment is both signed and recorded as sent. A signature alone does not finalize it.
steps.expectedResult: The available correction path is understood.

steps.title: Edit when still permitted
steps.action: Before finalization, reopen the relevant answer, make the factual correction and verify saving.
steps.expectedResult: The source saves the ordinary edit with history.
steps.exception: If finalization has occurred, use Add note instead of overwriting the answer.

steps.title: Add a note after finalization
steps.action: When Add note is available, enter the new information and reason using the source form, then save and inspect the attributed note.
steps.expectedResult: An appended note preserves the finalized answers.

steps.title: Inspect the history
steps.action: Verify the recorded correction. An explicit new assessment revision, when required, uses the source revision process rather than a duplicate referral.
steps.expectedResult: The old and new information remain traceable.

steps.title: Identify affected handoffs
steps.action: Check whether a previous handoff used the earlier version. Prepare any needed follow-up for the responsible person.
steps.expectedResult: A correction is not mistaken for notification to recipients.

exceptions: Historical submitted reviews retain their existing request-changes path.
Do not assume updating the chart updated an earlier sent packet.

agent.draftInstructions: Explain the factual change, cite old/new evidence, identify the permitted correction route and affected handoffs. Prepare a note or follow-up draft; do not rewrite finalized answers or notify recipients.
agent.humanDecision: Assessor chooses and saves the permitted correction; a responsible human handles any separately authorized follow-up.

procedures.title: Organize the workday
procedures.trigger: Starting work or returning to the queue.
procedures.outcome: The assessor has a source-linked list of next actions, appointments and unresolved work.
preconditions: Check the scope and freshness of the visible work.

steps.title: Read the Board
steps.action: Inspect the next action and stage on each relevant card. Do not equate age or stage alone with clinical urgency.
steps.expectedResult: Current visible work is understood.

steps.title: Check appointments
steps.action: Choose the relevant date range and permitted scope. Open a linked appointment for details.
steps.expectedResult: Appointments are matched to the correct cases.

steps.title: Review follow-ups
steps.action: Inspect recorded due/follow-up dates and owners. Use existing requests instead of creating a duplicate task.
steps.expectedResult: Open commitments and ownership are visible.

steps.title: Resume one case
steps.action: Open the case and let existing save/resume controls preserve work when switching.
steps.expectedResult: The next action is taken in the correct existing workspace.

exceptions: Unavailable or stale data is not an empty queue.
Time in a case and autosave counts do not measure effort.

agent.draftInstructions: Draft a work brief grouped by recorded appointments, open follow-ups and blockers, with source links. Explain ranking using actual dates/rules; do not invent deadlines or judge employee productivity.
agent.humanDecision: Assessor chooses priorities and confirms any change to source work.

procedures.title: Receive and maintain a referral
procedures.trigger: New referral information arrives or intake details change.
procedures.outcome: One correct canonical referral holds the verified intake information.
preconditions: Confirm intake is part of your assigned responsibility.
Check for an existing referral before starting another.

steps.title: Look for existing work
steps.action: Search using the available referral details and inspect the matching person/community.
steps.expectedResult: An existing episode is reused when appropriate.

steps.title: Open or start the intended intake
steps.action: Use the existing record when found. For genuinely new work, enter supplied identity details and verify the source.
steps.expectedResult: The correct intake is open.

steps.title: Record routing
steps.action: Enter verified routing details and select the correct linked assessor.
steps.expectedResult: Responsibility and routing are explicit.

steps.title: Attach the received records
steps.action: Choose the relevant files and check upload/processing results. Selected filenames alone do not prove upload.
steps.expectedResult: Actual uploaded records stay with this referral.

steps.title: Verify creation and saving
clickpath: Create referral when offered / saved status
steps.action: Use the source create/save action as applicable. Confirm the canonical referral exists; a recovered private draft may still need completion.
steps.expectedResult: The source confirms the referral identity and saved state.

exceptions: Do not create a new referral solely to resume existing work.
A matching name alone does not establish canonical identity.

agent.draftInstructions: Prepare a missing-intake checklist and potential duplicate/identity questions with source evidence. Never merge by name or create a referral automatically.
agent.humanDecision: Authorized intake owner verifies identity and saves the referral.

procedures.title: Add and review supporting evidence
procedures.trigger: A document arrives, extraction needs review or evidence is missing.
procedures.outcome: The correct evidence and its review state are traceable to the case.
preconditions: Verify the referral and authorized document access.

steps.title: Add to the existing case
steps.action: Choose the correct files and wait for the actual upload result.
steps.expectedResult: Files attach to the intended case.

steps.title: Inspect the original
steps.action: Check identity, date, source and relevant pages before using the content.
steps.expectedResult: The document has been inspected rather than inferred from its filename.

steps.title: Review extracted suggestions
steps.action: Use the available source-review controls to confirm or correct suggested values. Keep unresolved suggestions pending.
steps.expectedResult: The value’s provenance and review status are accurate.

steps.title: Verify the result
steps.action: Confirm the saved value and retained original. Do not remove a document as part of routine review.
steps.expectedResult: Evidence remains available with the correct saved state.

exceptions: Extraction success is not verification of every value.
If the wrong file is attached, use the source’s explicit removal/correction process only when authorized.

agent.draftInstructions: List missing or conflicting evidence and the specific source pages needed for review. Propose value corrections only from authorized content; retain the original reference.
agent.humanDecision: Human verifies documents and accepts or rejects extracted values.

procedures.title: Request information and coordinate follow-up
procedures.trigger: Work is waiting for records, clarification or coordination.
procedures.outcome: An attributable request and next follow-up remain visible to the responsible people.
preconditions: Use an approved contact and communication channel.
Confirm ownership and the information actually needed.

steps.title: Inspect existing requests
steps.action: Find the existing requirement and its responsible/requested-from details before starting another request.
steps.expectedResult: The missing item and current owner are identified.

steps.title: Prepare a precise request
steps.action: State what is needed, why it is needed for the task, and the next action. Include only authorized information.
steps.expectedResult: A clear request draft is ready for a human to review.

steps.title: Communicate through the approved process
steps.action: The responsible person communicates and records the factual response in the appropriate source field or request.
steps.expectedResult: Contact or response is recorded only if it actually occurred.

steps.title: Set the next follow-up
steps.action: Update the existing request’s follow-up details when supported and verify saving.
steps.expectedResult: The next commitment remains tied to the correct request.

exceptions: No response is not a negative answer.
No agent emails or other outbound messages are enabled.
Local contact/escalation ownership must be confirmed with Alamo.

agent.draftInstructions: Draft a focused request and a follow-up checklist. Preserve unknowns; identify which facts need a response. Do not choose unverified contacts, invent a response or send.
agent.humanDecision: Responsible person reviews and communicates, then records the actual result.

procedures.title: Transfer work or arrange coverage
procedures.trigger: A case changes owner or work needs coverage/escalation.
procedures.outcome: The receiving owner can identify current work, open commitments and unresolved issues.
preconditions: Verify the authorized receiving owner and local coverage process.

steps.title: Assemble the current context
steps.action: Identify the latest saved state, open questions and relevant evidence.
steps.expectedResult: A current transfer brief can be prepared.

steps.title: Review recorded ownership
steps.action: Inspect the current linked owner. Use the existing ownership control only when you are responsible and authorized to make the change.
steps.expectedResult: The intended responsibility change is explicit.

steps.title: Record the handoff reason
steps.action: Explain the reason and review any confirmation the source presents. Verify the saved owner after the change.
steps.expectedResult: Source ownership evidence reflects the actual transfer.

steps.title: Resolve acceptance or escalation
steps.action: Provide the brief through the approved human process and clarify who owns outstanding work. Record acceptance only where it is actually evidenced.
steps.expectedResult: Open commitments have a known next owner, or the unresolved handoff is explicit.

exceptions: Reading a shared case does not prove accepting responsibility.
Reassignment requires new access checks for retained agent results.

requiredContext: Recorded transfer reason and acceptance where available
agent.draftInstructions: Draft a transfer brief: case state, saved version, open items, due dates if recorded, proposed receiving owner and evidence. Stop if identity/assignment is ambiguous; do not reassign automatically.
agent.humanDecision: Authorized human changes ownership and confirms the coverage arrangement.

procedures.title: Follow through after the decision
procedures.trigger: A decision or handoff has been recorded and work remains.
procedures.outcome: Outstanding items and final responsibilities are visible until the source confirms their actual outcomes.
preconditions: Confirm which post-decision tasks belong to the assessor and which belong to another owner.

steps.title: Inspect the decision and date
steps.action: Read the actual outcome and known planned admission date.
steps.expectedResult: Accepted, declined and pending work remain distinct.

steps.title: Check outstanding work
steps.action: Review existing requests, evidence and owners. Continue the appropriate follow-up rather than assuming acceptance closed the work.
steps.expectedResult: Remaining commitments are visible.

steps.title: Check the handoff evidence
steps.action: Inspect recorded delivery when relevant. Treat recipient acknowledgment as separate evidence.
steps.expectedResult: The known handoff state is accurately described.

steps.title: Confirm the responsible next owner
steps.action: Clarify remaining tasks and obtain the appropriate source update. Admission confirmation stays with its authorized owner.
steps.expectedResult: The next responsibility or verified outcome is explicit.

exceptions: Acceptance or signature alone does not close all work.
Do not infer EHR receipt, actual admission or receiving-team acknowledgment from a packet preview.

agent.draftInstructions: Draft a follow-through brief with unresolved items, recorded owners and source evidence. Distinguish each milestone and explain missing proof without marking the case complete.
agent.humanDecision: Each responsible human completes their permitted source action; coordinator/admin confirms admission where required.

procedures.title: Recover and verify saved work
procedures.trigger: Saving, uploading or switching work encounters an error or conflict.
procedures.outcome: The assessor preserves pending work and establishes the actual saved source state.
preconditions: Keep the current editor open when it contains unsaved work.

steps.title: Read the save state
steps.action: Distinguish saved, saving, queued/offline, conflict and error states.
steps.expectedResult: The unresolved condition is identified.

steps.title: Use the existing recovery path
steps.action: Resume the correct private draft when creation did not finish. Re-select file bytes if requested; recovered filenames are not proof of upload.
steps.expectedResult: The original draft/case is resumed without duplication.

steps.title: Reconcile conflicting work
steps.action: Inspect the current source version and pending changes. Use the existing reconciliation controls; do not overwrite newer work blindly.
steps.expectedResult: The chosen resolution preserves the intended current information.

steps.title: Use backup only when needed
steps.action: Use the existing backup/import preview flow if appropriate. Inspect the preview and explicitly confirm any import; cancel if the scope is wrong.
steps.expectedResult: No imported change is claimed before source confirmation.

steps.title: Verify the final state
steps.action: Confirm source persistence and relevant recorded changes. If unresolved, provide the support owner with a minimal problem description through the approved process.
steps.expectedResult: Saved work or a clearly owned unresolved issue is established.

exceptions: A restored local draft is not a saved chart.
Avoid duplicate retries after an uncertain outcome; inspect source state.

agent.draftInstructions: Explain the actual error and identify the existing recovery path. Draft a minimal support description without private values. Never claim a successful save from a click, local recovery or filename.
agent.humanDecision: Human selects reconciliation/import actions and checks the saved outcome.

procedures.title: Learn and practice an assessor task
procedures.trigger: An assessor needs onboarding, a refresher or help with a task.
procedures.outcome: The learner understands the task and has practiced its controls without claiming real work completion.
preconditions: Use fictional information in practice.
Confirm the procedure applies to the current task and app version.

steps.title: Choose the procedure
steps.action: Read purpose, prerequisites and expected results. Use the procedure matching the actual job.
steps.expectedResult: The task and its boundaries are understood.

steps.title: Walk through the steps
steps.action: Follow the procedure and inspect expected results. Use notes for learning only, without client identifiers.
steps.expectedResult: Guidance is reviewed; its local completion is not a source transaction.

steps.title: Open the existing fictional tutorial
steps.action: Use the existing fictional referral path at /tutorials/referral. Show me where reveals a control without activating it.
steps.expectedResult: A fictional practice case is open.

steps.title: Practice and inspect the result
steps.action: Try the applicable controls, inspect the expected result, and repeat when needed. Simulate send sends nothing.
steps.expectedResult: A practice attempt is distinct from a real save, signature or delivery.

steps.title: Return to real work deliberately
steps.action: Return to ordinary work and verify the real case identity before acting. Record learning through an approved process if one exists.
steps.expectedResult: Practice state is not mistaken for clinical work or a formal qualification.

exceptions: Workflow walkthrough state is local/prototype.
Completing this tutorial does not award competency or new permissions.

agent.draftInstructions: Explain the task, select the matching procedure, and guide one step at a time with expected results. Keep practice separate from real work and pause when the source control/version does not match.
agent.humanDecision: Learner operates the controls; designated reviewers assess any required demonstration.

procedures.title: Propose a procedure or workflow improvement
procedures.trigger: An assessor finds confusing guidance, missing support or repeated handoff friction.
procedures.outcome: A specific evidence-backed change proposal is ready for the responsible content or product owner.
preconditions: Use permitted references and synthetic examples; do not paste identifiable case material into reusable lessons.

steps.title: Locate the affected instruction
steps.action: Identify the exact instruction and task where the problem occurs.
steps.expectedResult: The proposal refers to a specific procedure/task.

steps.title: Verify actual app behavior
steps.action: Compare the instruction with the source control and actual result. Preserve unknowns and differences in versions.
steps.expectedResult: The mismatch has a concrete source reference.

steps.title: Write the proposed change
steps.action: Describe the trigger, current step, observed problem, proposed wording or behavior, and expected result. Use a safe example.
steps.expectedResult: A reviewable proposal exists without silently changing policy.

steps.title: Separate the release decisions
steps.action: A reviewed procedure revision and an evaluated agent behavior change are separate decisions. Record the affected task and version when the owner publishes.
steps.expectedResult: A suggestion is not mislabeled as an approved or activated change.

exceptions: Repeated practice does not automatically become company policy.
Workflow has no verified submission/publishing API for this path yet; use the approved human review process.

agent.draftInstructions: Draft a change proposal with source references, rationale, revised instruction and affected tasks/skills. Mark inference and unknowns. Do not publish guidance or activate changed behavior automatically.
agent.humanDecision: Content owner reviews guidance; agent owner separately reviews any executable change.
